assertions.name: gprime0_differences_shrink_on_THIS_grid
assertions.note: successive differences [-0.006, -0.00485, -0.00349, -0.00068, -0.00141]. This is a property OF THIS COARSE GRID and is no longer read as convergence: `qbeta_covariance_kernel_class_basis_probe` section 6 shows g'(0) oscillates on a consecutive grid (quasi-period ~11, amplitude ~3e-4), so shrinking differences here reflect where 16,24,32,40,44,48 happens to sample the oscillation

assertions.name: gprime0_in_band_over_this_range_only
assertions.note: RETRACTION (bean `qou-igjo`): this was named `gprime0_approaches_quarter_from_below` and its -0.25 < g'(0) bound was read as evidence that -1/4 is the limit. The bound holds only because this grid stops at k = 48. g'(0) = -0.250311 at k = 52 and -0.250614 at k = 56 -- it CROSSES -1/4. The assertion is kept, scoped to its own range, and must not be quoted as an approach from below

assertions.name: earlier_coincidence_minus_one_over_two_pi_is_disfavoured
